answer_1.quote: Target-driven conversation systems focus on how to naturally lead users to accept the designated targets gradually through conversations.
answer_1.outputs: conversational responses and natural language plans for target-driven dialogue

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance of plans distilled, we adopt BERTScore and BARTScore to measure the semantic similarity between the plan and the original conversation.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 5 master students to serve as annotators for this project.
answer_4.guideline: Referring to , we adopted the following metrics to evaluate the quality of dialogues: (1) appropriateness (Appr.), which measures whether the utterance responds to the dialogue context appropriately, and ( ) informativeness (Info.), which measures whether the utterance is informative by making full use of the grounded knowledge. ( ) proactivity (Proact.), which measures whether a model proactively leads the dialogue; (4) coherence (Coh.), which manually examines whether the whole dialogue is fluent, coherent, and smoothly transited; (5) target success (Succ.), which estimates whether a model effectively reaches the target.
